description: Regression scenarios for evidence-first debugging, hypothesis ranking, and refusal to patch before root cause is identified.

evals.name: ranked-hypotheses-from-test-failure
evals.prompt: Debug a failing unit test where the log shows stale fixture state reused across test cases.

context.symptom: Expected missing output to fail, but validator returned PASS.
context.evidence: The same output path was written by an earlier test.

expected_behavior: Starts by restating the observed failure and available evidence.
Ranks 3–5 falsifiable hypotheses with evidence for and against each; selects one and changes one variable per experiment.
Identifies test isolation or stale fixture state as the leading cause before proposing code changes.
anti_behavior: Immediately editing validator logic without checking fixture state.
Listing many generic causes without ranking them.
Treating the failure as flaky without evidence.

evals.name: advisor-bounded-when-evidence-insufficient
evals.prompt: Debug an intermittent CI failure with only a one-line timeout message and no logs.

context.missing_evidence: failed step logs and recent diff

expected_behavior: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT or asks for the single highest-information probe.
Does not invent a root cause from the timeout alone.
If delegation is available, sends only a bounded packet to a root-cause advisor.
anti_behavior: Claiming the timeout is definitely network flakiness.
Requesting broad repository context before the failed step log.

evals.name: anti-human-error-terminal-cause
evals.prompt: Postmortem this failed release. The deployer forgot to run the migration.

context.incident: release failed because DB column was missing

expected_behavior: Refuses to stop at human error as the terminal cause.
Identifies the missing system guard, checklist, CI migration gate, or release automation gap.
Separates primary cause from contributing factors.
anti_behavior: Writing 'human error' as the root cause and stopping.

evals.name: analyst-valid-mode
evals.prompt: Use ywc-debug-rootcause with an available read-only analyst and bounded causal evidence.
expected_behavior: Dispatch Caller: ywc-debug-rootcause and analysis_mode=debug_hypotheses.
Validate Status/Summary/Finding counts and matching Analysis mode before consuming advice.
Retain the caller decision gate; analyst returns inline advice only.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: analyst-refuses-invalid-contract
evals.prompt: The analyst packet has an omitted or unknown caller/mode, a cross-paired valid mode, or a malformed output envelope.
expected_behavior: Return NEEDS_CONTEXT; no inference, mode fallthrough or repeated dispatch.
Retain original caller gate and dispatch budget.
Record UNVERIFIED — instruction contract only without a live trace.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: feedback-manual-evidence
evals.prompt: No automated reproduction is possible; bounded manual observations are supplied.
expected_behavior: Record Feedback loop, Catches, Misses and the observed failure before any fix.
Record manual evidence and constraints; do not fabricate RED or test execution PASS.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: fourth-fix-refusal
evals.prompt: Three failed fixes; only Fix #4 signal: fix harder is supplied, or both signals lack evidence.
expected_behavior: Stop; no fourth attempt unless both separate fields are evidence-linked and from the valid debug pair.
Unavailable analyst, other mode or malformed response keeps stop in force.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: fourth-fix-once
evals.prompt: Three failed fixes and a valid debug analyst response with both separate evidence-linked Fix #4 signal: fix harder and Next fix worth attempting: one concrete minimal change.
expected_behavior: Allow exactly one final fourth fix changing one variable; verify through original regression gate.
After a failed fourth fix, stop; no fifth attempt or reset.
Route architecture concerns to ywc-architect; analyst makes no final architecture verdict.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence
